claims.statement: E2 vs E1 reward advantage: point estimates positive in both segments; robustness varies by clustering dimension
claims.evidence: p25_return significant under BOTH cluster units in BOTH segments (val +0.0061 p<0.001 stock & T0; conf +0.0060/+0.0060 p<0.001/p=0.013). median_return & p_positive: significant under both units in validation, but confirmation T0_date CI crosses zero (median p=0.19, p_positive p=0.104). claims.evidence: stock_code: val -0.0135 [-0.0198,-0.0074] p<0.001; conf -0.0139 [-0.0224,-0.0050] p=0.001. T0_date: val -0.0135 [-0.0263,+0.0005] p=0.059; conf -0.0139 [-0.0317,+0.0021] p=0.094.
